primary_rules.estimand: Mean paired treatment-minus-control value_update across all task-match pairs.
Mean paired treatment-minus-control value_update across all task-mismatch pairs.

primary_multiplicity: Bonferroni correction for two primary rules; each two-sided sign-flip p-value must be <= 0.025 and its 95% paired bootstrap interval must exclude zero in the expected direction.
cross_field_requirement: Each primary rule must have the expected mean direction in at least four of five field groups.
execution_requirement: All planned pairs complete and every control seller disclosure preserves the target property as unresolved.
secondary_outcomes: paired agreed-price effect among pairs agreeing in both arms
price_propagation_criterion: At least 20 both-arm agreements, positive match-stratum price effect, and two-sided sign-flip p <= 0.05.

sample_size_rationale.note: The independent sample matches the development sample size and substantially exceeds the size needed for the observed value-update effects while retaining five-field coverage.
